name: CI ubuntu fix check
command: cd /Users/ivan_krapivev/ChillTransfer && sleep 90 && for i in $(seq 1 25); do line=$(gh run list --branch feature/ci-cross-platform-fixes --limit 1 | head -1); st=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1}'); if [ "$st" = "completed" ]; then id=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $6}'); concl=$(gh run view $id -q .conclusion); echo "CI RUN $id CONCLUSION: $concl"; if [ "$concl" != "success" ]; then gh run view $id --log-failed 2>/dev/null | grep -E "FAIL|fatal error|##\[error\]" | head -25; fi; break; fi; sleep 60; done
